**Coaching Note (76 words):**

When your opponent gives check with a piece, look for checks *back* that win material. Here, the knight on d5 was undefended after giving check. Rxd5+ captures it with check, forcing White's bishop to recapture. Then your rook takes the undefended rook on c1 with check again—the king must take, and you've won a full knight through two forcing moves. Always count material after exchanges to confirm your advantage.
